instruction: Download the archive to release.tgz, failing on HTTP errors and retrying transient failures four times.
context: curl: --fail rejects HTTP errors, --location follows redirects, --retry takes a count, and --output takes the destination path.

instruction: Request the API as JSON with a bearer token from TOKEN and print response headers too.
context: curl: --include prints response headers and each --header supplies one request header.

instruction: POST payload.json as JSON and fail while retaining the body if the server returns an error.
context: curl: --fail-with-body retains an error body, --request selects POST, --header sets media type, and --data @file reads a file.

instruction: Fetch the health endpoint with a two-second connection timeout and an eight-second total timeout.
context: curl: --connect-timeout limits connection establishment while --max-time limits the complete transfer.

instruction: Fetch the page using response compression, suppress progress, but still display errors.
context: curl: --compressed negotiates compression, --silent hides progress, and --show-error restores errors.

instruction: Follow redirects and fetch only response headers for the download URL.
context: curl: --head performs a headers-only request and --location follows redirects.

instruction: Show the last twenty commits by Sam since July 1 in one-line format.
context: git log: --oneline compacts commits, --max-count limits results, --author filters identity, and --since sets a date boundary.

instruction: List only names of added or modified files staged for commit.
context: git diff: --cached selects the index, --name-only omits patches, and --diff-filter=AM keeps added and modified paths.

instruction: List local branches already merged into main with verbose commit details.
context: git branch: --merged takes the reference whose reachable branches are selected; --verbose adds commit details.

instruction: Fetch all remotes, remove stale remote branches, and update tags.
context: git fetch: --all visits every remote, --prune removes deleted remote refs, and --tags fetches tags.

instruction: Print machine-readable status including ignored and all untracked files.
context: git status: --porcelain is stable machine output, --ignored includes ignored paths, and --untracked-files=all lists individual files.

instruction: Preview removing ignored and untracked directories without deleting anything.
context: git clean: --dry-run previews, -d includes directories, and -x includes ignored files.

instruction: List production pods labeled app=api in wide format.
response: kubectl get pods --namespace production --selector app=api --output wide
context: kubectl get: --namespace selects scope, --selector takes a label expression, and --output wide adds placement details.

instruction: Wait at most three minutes for the api deployment rollout in staging.
context: kubectl rollout status waits for completion; --namespace selects scope and --timeout takes a duration.

instruction: Describe worker-2 and include cluster events in the output.
context: kubectl describe node selects a node and --show-events controls inclusion of related events.

instruction: Delete pod api-7d9f from staging with a thirty-second grace period and wait for completion.
context: kubectl delete: --namespace scopes the object, --grace-period takes seconds, and --wait controls completion waiting.

instruction: Show CPU and memory for every container in production pods.
context: kubectl top pods reports resource use; --namespace scopes it and --containers breaks totals down by container.

instruction: List warning events in staging sorted by their last timestamp.
context: kubectl get events: --field-selector filters server-side, --sort-by takes a JSON field, and --namespace selects scope.

instruction: Run integration-marked tests using four workers and stop after two failures.
context: pytest: -m selects markers, -n takes a worker count with xdist, and --maxfail sets the failure budget.

instruction: Run verbose tests whose names contain parser but exclude slow-marked tests.
context: pytest: --verbose expands output, -k filters names, and -m filters marker expressions.

instruction: Rerun only tests that failed last time and stop at the first failure.
context: pytest: --last-failed selects cached failures and --maxfail=1 stops after the first failure.

instruction: Run unit tests quietly and report the ten slowest durations.
context: pytest: -q reduces output, the path limits collection, and --durations takes a count.

instruction: Run API tests with stdout uncaptured and live logs at debug level.
context: pytest: --capture=no exposes stdout and --log-cli-level takes the live logging threshold.

instruction: Run test_decode in tests/test_parser.py and enter the debugger on failure.
context: pytest: a double-colon node ID selects one test and --pdb enters the debugger on failure.

instruction: Check src for unused imports and undefined names while excluding generated files.
context: ruff check: --select takes comma-separated codes and --exclude takes a pattern before target paths.

instruction: Preview safe lint fixes for the project as a diff without modifying files.
context: ruff check: --fix enables safe fixes and --diff prints the proposed patch without writing.

instruction: Lint using GitHub Actions annotation output and return nonzero if fixes are available.
context: ruff check: --output-format=github emits annotations and --exit-non-zero-on-fix changes exit policy.

instruction: Check formatting only for src and tests and show the diff without rewriting.
context: ruff format: --check verifies, --diff prints changes, and multiple path operands restrict scope.

instruction: Lint the project and print violation counts grouped by rule.
context: ruff check: --statistics adds aggregated counts by rule while dot selects the project tree.

instruction: Check src while ignoring inline noqa suppressions and selecting all Pyflakes rules.
context: ruff check: --ignore-noqa disables inline suppression and --select F enables Pyflakes rules.

instruction: Search Rust files for unsafe with three lines of context and line numbers.
context: ripgrep: --type takes a known file type, --context takes a line count, and --line-number enables locations.

instruction: Count matching lines containing ERROR in log files while excluding archived logs.
context: ripgrep: --count reports matching-line counts and repeated --glob rules include and exclude paths.

instruction: List files including hidden ones but exclude everything under target.
context: ripgrep: --files lists candidate paths, --hidden includes dotfiles, and a negated --glob excludes a subtree.

instruction: Preview replacing colour with color in output, never emitting terminal colors.
context: ripgrep: --replace changes displayed matches and --color never disables ANSI coloring; files remain untouched.

instruction: Search across line boundaries for begin followed later by end, allowing dot to match newlines.
context: ripgrep: --multiline permits cross-line matches and --multiline-dotall makes dot include newlines.

instruction: Use PCRE2 to find whole words beginning with foo followed by digits, case-insensitively.
context: ripgrep: --pcre2 enables PCRE2 escapes, --word-regexp requires boundaries, and --ignore-case folds case.

instruction: Archive-copy src to backup with compression and overall progress, preserving partial transfers.
context: rsync: --archive preserves metadata, --compress reduces transport, --info=progress2 reports progress, and --partial retains partial files.

instruction: Mirror project into deploy, deleting stale files but excluding .git and target directories.
context: rsync: --delete removes destination-only files, each --exclude supplies one pattern, and --archive preserves the tree.

instruction: Copy data to backup.example.com over SSH port 2222 with archive mode and compression.
context: rsync: --rsh takes the remote-shell command as one argument; --archive and --compress preserve and compress.

instruction: Copy only files no larger than ten megabytes and never overwrite newer destination files.
context: rsync: --max-size sets an upper transfer bound, --update skips newer destination files, and --archive preserves metadata.

instruction: Preview an archive sync using checksums and itemize every proposed change.
context: rsync: --checksum changes comparison, --dry-run prevents writes, and --itemize-changes explains updates.

instruction: Move only files already present at the destination, removing each transferred source file.
context: rsync: --existing skips new destination paths and --remove-source-files deletes successfully transferred sources.

instruction: Connect to deploy@example.com on port 2222 using the deploy key and disable password authentication.
context: ssh: -p takes the port, -i takes the identity file, and -o supplies a configuration option.

instruction: Forward local port 5433 to database.internal port 5432 through bastion without starting a remote command.
context: ssh: -N suppresses a remote command and -L takes local-port:host:remote-port.

instruction: Expose local port 3000 as port 8080 on gateway and do not open a shell.
context: ssh: -R takes remote-port:host:local-port for reverse forwarding and -N disables a remote command.

instruction: Connect to app.internal through jump.example.com using agent forwarding and compression.
context: ssh: -J selects a jump host, -A forwards the authentication agent, and -C enables compression.

instruction: Force a terminal while running sudo journalctl on server.example.com.
context: ssh: -t forces pseudo-terminal allocation; operands after the host form the remote command.

instruction: Connect in batch mode using a dedicated known-hosts file and require strict host checking.
context: ssh: repeated -o arguments set batch authentication, known-hosts path, and strict verification.

instruction: Find regular log files under logs modified in the last day and larger than one megabyte.
context: find: -type f selects files, -name filters names, -mtime -1 means less than one day, and -size +1M sets a lower bound.

instruction: Delete empty regular files below cache while printing each path first.
context: find: -empty selects zero-length files, -print reports them, and -delete removes matches.

instruction: Find files owned by deploy that are writable by group or others.
context: GNU find: -user filters ownership and -perm /022 matches any group-or-other write bit.

instruction: Within two levels under src, run wc -l once per Python file.
context: GNU find: -maxdepth limits descent, -name filters paths, and -exec command {} semicolon invokes once per match.

instruction: Find JavaScript files while skipping node_modules directories.
context: find: -prune stops descent into matching directories; -o joins the alternate file-selection branch.

instruction: Find regular files with more than one hard link and print inode, link count, and path.
context: GNU find: -links +1 selects multiply linked files and -printf formats inode, link count, and path.

instruction: Show the latest 100 nginx service messages without a pager and include precise timestamps.
context: journalctl: --unit filters a unit, --lines takes a count, --no-pager disables paging, and --output selects rendering.

instruction: Show api service logs between 09:00 and 10:30 today in UTC.
context: journalctl: --since and --until bound time, --unit filters service messages, and --utc displays UTC.

instruction: Search current-boot journal messages for timeout case-insensitively and show catalog explanations.
context: journalctl: --boot selects the current boot, --grep takes a pattern, --case-sensitive controls matching, and --catalog adds explanations.

instruction: Remove archived journal data older than fourteen days and report disk usage afterward.
context: journalctl: --vacuum-time removes archived files older than a duration and --disk-usage reports storage.

instruction: Emit current-boot kernel messages as one JSON object per line with selected fields.
context: journalctl: --dmesg restricts kernel messages, --output=json emits JSON lines, and --output-fields takes comma-separated fields.

instruction: Follow new messages for the current user's sync service starting without backlog.
context: journalctl: --user selects the user journal, --unit filters service, --follow streams, and --lines 0 suppresses backlog.

instruction: Enable nginx at boot and start it immediately without blocking for completion.
context: systemctl enable: --now also starts the unit and --no-block returns after queuing the job.

instruction: Restart api.service and wait until its queued job completes.
context: systemctl restart stops and starts the unit; --wait waits until the triggered job completes.

instruction: List running service units in plain output without column headings.
context: systemctl list-units: --type and --state filter, --all includes loaded units, and --no-legend removes headings.

instruction: Show all units that depend on network.target, including indirect dependencies.
context: systemctl list-dependencies: --reverse shows dependents and --all includes indirect dependencies.

instruction: Temporarily mask debug.service until the next boot and stop it now.
context: systemctl mask: --runtime creates a transient mask and --now stops the unit immediately.

instruction: Print nginx.service and all its drop-in configuration without a pager.
context: systemctl cat prints the unit fragment plus drop-ins and --no-pager writes directly to stdout.

instruction: Print the subject, issuer, and validity dates from cert.pem without dumping the encoded certificate.
context: openssl x509: -in selects the certificate, -noout suppresses encoding, and -subject, -issuer, and -dates select fields.

instruction: Check private.pem for RSA key consistency without printing key material.
context: openssl rsa: -in selects the key, -check validates consistency, and -noout suppresses key output.

instruction: Compute a binary SHA-256 digest of artifact.bin and write it to artifact.sha256.
context: openssl dgst: -sha256 selects the digest, -binary emits raw bytes, and -out takes the output path.

instruction: Generate 32 cryptographically random bytes encoded as base64.
context: openssl rand: -base64 encodes output and the numeric operand is the byte count before encoding.

instruction: Inspect bundle.p12 metadata without outputting certificates or private keys.
context: openssl pkcs12: -in selects the bundle, -info displays structure, and -noout suppresses extracted credentials.

instruction: Verify server.pem using roots.pem and intermediates.pem for server authentication.
response: openssl verify -CAfile roots.pem -untrusted intermediates.pem -purpose sslserver server.pem
context: openssl verify: -CAfile supplies roots, -untrusted supplies intermediates, and -purpose sslserver applies server-auth checks.
